blocks.text: PARIS — Gérard Depardieu, for decades one of France’s most celebrated actors, has been ordered to stand trial on charges of raping and sexually assaulting a young actress, authorities said Thursday, Nov. 26, less than two weeks after the cinema star abandoned his appeal of a sexual assault conviction in a separate case. Actress Charlotte Arnould was 22 when she accused Depardieu in 2018 of raping her at his Paris home. Eight years later, the Paris Court of Appeal ruled that the actor should face trial over allegations of rape and sexual assault on Aug. 7, 2018, while dismissing allegations relating […]...
